# Gumroad Market Data

> An open dataset of 1,344 Gumroad product listings across 42 categories, collected from public search result pages and normalised to USD. Median price $35.00; 34% of listings have no ratings at all. CC BY 4.0. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21830103.

## How to read the numbers

- A row is a listing *observation*, not a product: one product can rank for several category searches. 1,509 observations cover 1,344 distinct products (165 duplicates). Per-category figures count a product in each category it ranks for; every market-wide figure counts it once.
- Prices are converted to USD at European Central Bank reference rates for 2026-08-06. Mixing currencies without converting was a real error in an earlier version of this dataset and it moved the medians.
- Rating counts are a floor on units sold, not a sales figure. Gumroad does publish a per-product `sales_count` on product pages where the seller opted into showing it, but it is absent on most listings, and absent does not mean zero. The sales-per-rating ratio is not published here because the sample that carries both fields is still too small to state one.
- 72 listings are free and 458 are unrated. Both distort any average taken across the whole file; the medians above exclude neither, so quote them as medians.

## Data

- [Full CSV, tagged release](https://github.com/sujeito-operator/gumroad-market-data/releases/download/v1.1/gumroad-latest.csv): the exact bytes every figure here was computed from. `main` moves; this tag does not.
- [50-row sample](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/gumroad-market-data/sample-50-rows.csv): the column shape, no download.
- [summary.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sujeito-operator/gumroad-market-data/main/data/summary.json): every published figure as JSON.
- [Repository](https://github.com/sujeito-operator/gumroad-market-data): collection and normalisation scripts.
- [Zenodo record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21830103): citable, versioned archive.

## Second sample: Gumroad's own category taxonomy

> A larger, independently collected sample whose frame is Gumroad's published category tree rather than 42 chosen search terms: **8,325 distinct products from 4,545 distinct sellers across 261 categories**, in 15,077 listing observations. Median paid asking price $18.03; 43% of products carry no ratings.

Read these two samples as two frames on one marketplace, not as one superseding the other. They disagree, and the disagreement is the finding: the search-term sample puts the median paid price at $36.99 and the taxonomy walk at $18.03, because popular search terms never surface the cheaper depths of the catalogue.

- Products are keyed on product URL, an exact identity key. 6,752 products are filed by Gumroad under more than one category.
- **A category's listing count is a crawl depth, not a category size.** Each node was taken up to three pages deep, capping it at 71 listings; 166 of 261 nodes hit that cap. Never quote it as the number of products in a category.
- 98 of the 359 crawled nodes returned no listings and are excluded rather than reported as zeroes.
- Seller concentration, measurable here for the first time: the top 1% of sellers hold 52.5% of all ratings and the top 10% hold 89.2%. 3,263 of the 4,545 sellers have exactly one product in the sample.

- [Taxonomy CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sujeito-operator/gumroad-market-data/main/data/gumroad-taxonomy.csv): 15,077 rows with category, product URL, seller, price, currency, USD price, rating count, star rating, subscription flag, title.
- [taxonomy-summary.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sujeito-operator/gumroad-market-data/main/data/taxonomy-summary.json): every per-category figure as JSON.
- [All 261 categories, ranked](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/gumroad-market-data/t/index.html)
